name: Forno Acqua AcquaFALL Mini Polished Chrome 8" Retrofit Shower System
shortDescription: Turn your daily shower into a spa-like escape with the FORNO ACQUA Mini AcquaSPA Shower System. Perfect for compact bathrooms, guest suites, or apartments, this 3-in-1 space-saving system includes a U.S.-patented 6-function rain shower head, a 5-function handheld, and a 10-1/2 in. AcquaFALL Waterfall Jet for full-body relaxation or focused muscle relief. The adjustable jet adapts to all user heights for personalized comfort. With a water-efficient 1.8 GPM flow rate, it conserves water while maintaining a satisfying shower experience. Wall-mounted for quick DIY installation and finished in polished chrome, the Mini AcquaSPA offers a sleek, modern look without sacrificing performance or luxury.

features.text: Patented 6-Function 8" Rain Shower Head for a Personalized Spa Experience: Enjoy a luxurious full-body experience with six soothing overhead spray modes
5-Function Handheld Shower with 60" Hose for Targeted Relief: Ergonomic handheld sprayer includes Rain, Massage, Pulse and Combo functions.

3 AcquaSPA Adjustable, Directional Body Jets are Precisely Spaced for True Full-Body Relief: Experience targeted relief for upper, mid, and lower muscle zones - customized spa-quality comfort for every body
Easy DIY Installation with Existing Plumbing on Flat or Uneven Surfaces: Fits standard plumbing - quick, no-fuss at-home installation
6-Way Diverter Offers Full Control of Shower Functions: Switch with ease; rain shower, handheld, or jets. Mix and match for a custom spa feel.
Integrated Sliding Bar with Adjustable Holder for Handheld Flexibility: Adjustable handheld shower, custom height and angle for easier use by children, seniors, and every family member.
